resources.string: Lets the Silicons you allow on extend.teamofsilicons.com see this screen and act on it. A notification or badge always shows when a Silicon is using this device, with a Stop button.

Silicon Extend reads what is on the screen and taps, types, scrolls and presses buttons for a Silicon you gave access to this device. Nothing happens unless a Silicon with access starts a session, and you can stop it at any moment from the notification, the Silicon Extend app or the website. Turn this off to stop Silicons from using this device.
